newsitem.title: NORWAY: Fokus share up in heavy trade in Oslo.
newsitem.headline: Fokus share up in heavy trade in Oslo.

text.p: Nearly three percent of shares in Fokus Bank, target of a hostile takeover attempt, were traded on Friday morning on the Oslo Stock Exchange and the share was up 5.30 percent at 69.50 crowns at 0930 GMT.
Sparebankgruppen, a group of 16 Norwegian savings banks bidding 73 crowns per share for Fokus, denied it was involved in Friday's purchases of the share.
"I don't know about these blocks of shares," Sparebankgruppen managing director Tor Laegreid told Reuters.
Union Bank of Norway also said it was not involved in the transactions.
Sparebankgruppen's bid for Fokus is due to expire at 1400 GMT on Friday, but Laegreid has said it may take until next week before the savings banks decide whether to extend the offer or not.
The board of Fokus is fighting the bid by Sparebankgruppen, which wants to carve up Norway's fourth largest bank.
